34761-dr-adriaan.title: Dr. Adriaan
34761-dr-adriaan.creator: Louis Couperus
34761-dr-adriaan.description: A book by Louis Couperus. shrubs dipped along the road-side; and the few people who went along--an old gentleman; a peasant-woman; two poor children carrying a basket and followed by a melancholy, big, rough-coated dog--seemed to hang their heads low under the solemn weight of the clouds and the fierce mastery of the wind, which had months ago blown the smile from the now humble, frowning, pensive landscape. The soul of that landscape appeared small and all forlorn in the watery mists of the dreary winter.

arxiv-1606-07241.title: Joint User Association and Downlink Beamforming for Green Cloud-RANs with Limited Fronthaul
arxiv-1606-07241.creator: Zhi Yu, Ke Wang, Hong Ji, Xi Li, Heli Zhang
arxiv-1606-07241.description: Abstract With the explosive growth of smart devices and mobile data traffic, limited fronthaul capacity has become a notable bottleneck of green communication access networks, such as cloud radio access networks(C-RANs). In this paper, we proposed a joint user association and downlink beamforming scheme for green C-RANs to minimize the network power consumption with the limited fronthaul links.

arxiv-2202-05772.title: New insights on carbon black suspension rheology - anisotropic thixotropy and anti-thixotropy
arxiv-2202-05772.creator: Y. Wang, R. H. Ewoldt
arxiv-2202-05772.description: Abstract Abstract: We report a detailed experimental study of peculiar thixotropic dynamics of carbon black (CB, Vulcan XC-72) suspensions in mineral oil, specifically the observation of sequential stress increase then decrease at a fixed shear rate in a step-down test. We verify that such dynamics, though peculiar, come from a true material response rather than experimental artifacts.

arxiv-2203-00118.title: A Gelfand Transform for Spinor Fields on Embedded Riemannian Manifolds
arxiv-2203-00118.creator: Colin Roberts
arxiv-2203-00118.description: Abstract A classical result of Gelfand shows that the topologized spectrum of characters on commutative Banach algebra is homeomorphic to the underlying space. This fact is used in solving the Calderón problem in dimension 2 via the boundary control (BC) method .

arxiv-2209-06451.title: Lightweight 1-D CNN-based Timing Synchronization for OFDM Systems with CIR Uncertainty
arxiv-2209-06451.creator: Chaojin Qing, Shuhai Tang, Xi Cai, and Jiafan Wang
arxiv-2209-06451.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Chaojin Qing, Shuhai Tang, Xi Cai, and Jiafan Wang. In this letter, a lightweight one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1-D CNN)-based timing synchronization (TS) method is proposed to reduce the computational complexity and processing delay and hold the timing accuracy in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems.

arxiv-2212-01115.title: Some properties of the solution of the vertical tensor complementarity problem Thanks: This research was supported by National Natural Science Foundations of China (No. 11961082).
arxiv-2212-01115.creator: Li-Ming Li, Shi-Liang Wu
arxiv-2212-01115.description: Abstract In this paper, we mainly focus on the existence and uniqueness of the vertical tensor complementarity problem. Firstly, combining the generalized-order linear complementarity problem with the tensor complementarity problem, the vertical tensor complementarity problem is introduced. Secondly, we define some sets of special tensors, and illustrate the inclusion relationships.

arxiv-2212-06381.title: Core shells and double bubbles in a weighted nonlocal isoperimetric problem
arxiv-2212-06381.creator: Stanley Alama, Lia Bronsard, Xinyang Lu, Chong Wang
arxiv-2212-06381.description: Abstract We consider a sharp-interface model of A ​ B ​ C ABC triblock copolymers, for which the surface tension σ i ​ j \sigma_{ij} across the interface separating phase i i from phase j j may depend on the components.

arxiv-2302-10252.title: Monetary Policy, Digital Assets, and DeFi Activity
arxiv-2302-10252.creator: Antzelos Kyriazis, Iason Ofeidis, Georgios Palaiokrassas, Leandros Tassiulas
arxiv-2302-10252.description: Abstract This paper studies the effects of unexpected changes in US monetary policy on digital asset returns. We use event study regressions and find that monetary policy surprises negatively affect BTC and ETH, the two largest digital assets, but do not significantly affect the rest of the market.

arxiv-2312-17575.title: CAD-compatible structural shape optimization with a movable Bézier tetrahedral mesh
arxiv-2312-17575.creator: Jorge López, Cosmin Anitescu, Timon Rabczuk
arxiv-2312-17575.description: Abstract This paper presents the development of a complete CAD-compatible framework for structural shape optimization in 3D. The boundaries of the domain are described using NURBS while the interior is discretized with Bézier tetrahedra. The tetrahedral mesh is obtained from the mesh generator software Gmsh.

arxiv-2412-10678.title: Efficient Summation of Arbitrary Masks − - ESAM
arxiv-2412-10678.creator: V. Gupta, K. W. Bannister, C. Flynn, C. James
arxiv-2412-10678.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by V. Gupta, K. W. Bannister, C. Flynn, C. James. Searches for impulsive, astrophysical transients are often highly computationally demanding. A notable example is the dedispersion process required for performing blind searches for Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) in radio telescope data. We introduce a novel approach — Efficient Summation of Arbitrary Masks (ESAM) — which efficiently computes 1-D convolution of many arbitrary 2-D masks, and can be used to carry out dedispersion over thousands of dispersion trials efficiently.

arxiv-2503-14578.title: Introduction of the G 2 -Ricci Flow: Geometric Implications for Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking and Gauge Boson Masses
arxiv-2503-14578.creator: Richard Pinčák, Alexander Pigazzini, Michal Pudlák, Erik Bartoš
arxiv-2503-14578.description: Abstract This work introduces the G 2 -Ricci flow on seven-dimensional manifolds with non-zero torsion and explores its physical implications. By extending the Ricci flow to manifolds with G 2 structures, we study the evolution of solitonic solutions and their role in spontaneous symmetry breaking in gauge theories.

arxiv-2504-06699.title: Benchmarking Convolutional Neural Network and Graph Neural Network based Surrogate Models on a Real-World Car External Aerodynamics Dataset
arxiv-2504-06699.creator: Sam Jacob Jacob, Markus Mrosek, Carsten Othmer, Harald Köstler
arxiv-2504-06699.description: Abstract Aerodynamic optimization is crucial for developing eco-friendly, aerodynamic, and stylish cars, which requires close collaboration between aerodynamicists and stylists, a collaboration impaired by the time-consuming nature of aerodynamic simulations. Surrogate models offer a viable solution to reduce this overhead, but they are untested in real-world aerodynamic datasets.

arxiv-2505-02188.title: Generalized Double Operator Integrals for Continuous Spectrum Operators
arxiv-2505-02188.creator: Shih-Yu Chang
arxiv-2505-02188.description: Abstract Continuous spectrum operators (CSOs), characterized by spectra comprising continuous intervals rather than discrete eigenvalues, are pivotal in quantum mechanics, wave propagation, and systems governed by partial differential equations. Traditional double operator integrals (DOIs)—central to analyzing operator functions and perturbations—have been limited to operators with finite or countable spectra, relying critically on self-adjointness.

arxiv-2602-21734.creator: Selin Coban, Miguel Perez, Horst Lichter
arxiv-2602-21734.description: Abstract . Prototyping plays a critical role in the development of machine learning (ML) solutions, yet existing tools often provide limited support for effective collaboration and knowledge reuse among stakeholders. This paper introduces Proto-ML , an IDE designed to strengthen ML prototyping workflows.

pmc-11450205.title: Effects of conservative-militant defection strategies on the evolution of cooperation in social dilemma
pmc-11450205.creator: Sida Kang, Zhiyi Liu, Yuhan Hu, Hongyu Liu
pmc-11450205.description: Competition in the international arena and business realm offers avenues for individual growth and advancement. Individuals using different means of competition can obtain unequal rewards. This paper claims that when no consensus is reached in business activities, defectors will choose conservative or militant defection strategies during market competition.

pmc-11455163.title: 6699 Primary Hyperparathyroidism With Severe Hypercalcemia Secondary to Giant Parathyroid Adenoma
pmc-11455163.creator: M P Lieberman-Ulm, M A Yanez-Bello, V S Lagari-Libhaber
pmc-11455163.description: Disclosure: M.P. Lieberman-Ulm: None. M.A. Yanez-Bello: None. V.S. Lagari-Libhaber: None. Background: Parathyroid adenomas are often detected in asymptomatic patients without palpable neck mass and are responsible for 80 to 85% of cases of primary hyperparathyroidism. Oversized or “Giant” parathyroid adenomas (GPAs) are defined as parathyroid adenomas that weigh more than 3.5 g. These are rare, representing less than 1.

pmc-13100058.title: Preparation of motion sensor using AgNWs material and performance analysis in sports activities
pmc-13100058.creator: Huayi Wang
pmc-13100058.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). High-performance motion sensors are crucial for scientific training and health management. However, existing flexible strain sensors often face limitations in signal stability, response speed, and signal-to-noise ratio during dynamic monitoring, which hinders reliable high-precision data acquisition. To address these challenges, this study aimed to develop a novel strain sensor by focusing on optimizing the composite process of conductive materials and flexible substrates, thereby enhancing performance for practical human motion monitoring applications.

pmc-13122436.title: A Modern Ghost Story: Increased Selective Mortality of Salmon Under Climate Extremes
pmc-13122436.creator: Anna M Sturrock, Kirsten Sellheim, Joseph Merz, Jamie Sweeney, Miranda Bell‐Tilcock, George Whitman, Kohma Arai, Malte Willmes, Carson Jeffres, Rachel C Johnson
pmc-13122436.description: Hydroclimate volatility poses a growing threat to species' persistence, particularly when combined with widespread habitat loss and other stressors. Although the negative impacts of drought on aquatic species are well documented, wet conditions are generally assumed to enhance recruitment of migratory species during freshwater life stages.

pmc-13179425.title: Second-Trimester Uterine Rupture After Conservative Myomectomy: A Case Report and Institutional Perspective
pmc-13179425.creator: Platon Machavariani, Nickolas Kintraia, Natia Pkhaladze, Patman Tsaava, Ketevan Chichua
pmc-13179425.description: Uterine rupture following myomectomy represents a rare but severe complication of pregnancy, with a reported incidence of less than 1%. It most commonly occurs during the late second or third trimester and is associated with significant maternal hemorrhage and fetal compromise.

pmc-13285207.title: Mental health care access among Latinx and Indigenous Mexican immigrants in rural desert communities in the COVID-19 pandemic: a community-engaged study
pmc-13285207.creator: Noah Baltrushes, James Elkins, Stephanie Martinez, Ann Marie Cheney
pmc-13285207.description: BackgroundStructural and social inequities greatly impacted the mental and physical health of Latinx and Indigenous Mexican populations Hispanic/Latino immigrants in rural communities in the COVID-19 pandemic. These populations experienced disproportionate infection and mortality rates, exacerbated by existing structural and social inequities, creating unique stressors that negatively impacted community members’ mental health.

pmc-13585453.title: Bleeding-related conditions, procedural safety, and mortality after left atrial appendage closure
pmc-13585453.creator: Grégoire Massoullié, Come Fleury, Emeline Tourret, Simon Berger, Catherine Basthier-Denis, Guillaume Clerfond, Pierre-Antoine Catalan, Aurélie Chalard, Clément Riocreux, Aurélien Lebreton, Bruno Pereira, Romain Eschalier
pmc-13585453.description: on.1,2 In daily practice, referral is often driven by bleeding-prone conditions—thrombocytopenia, advanced renal dysfunction, severe anaemia, or advanced age—that may be intuitively perceived as procedural risk. We hypothesized that these conditions mainly reflect long-term clinical-biological vulnerability rather than acute procedural hazard. We retrospectively analysed 747 consecutive patients undergoing LAAC between 2016 and 2023 in a tertiary centre.
